description: MainActivity.java defines an Android activity that serves as a launcher for sample activities within the project. It displays a grid of sample options, each leading to different activities when clicked.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays a grid of sample activities for navigation.

classes.name: SampleAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for populating the grid with sample items.

classes.name: Sample
classes.description: Data class representing a sample item with title, description, and intent.

methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the grid view and sample list.

methods.description: Handles click events on grid items to launch corresponding activities.
